scientific.integrity: The primary full PDF was inspected at model (1), its initial conditions, the n=50 chronic-infection discussion, and the associated figures. A broader germinal-center selection model and a later chronic-HIV germinal-center model were compared for implication coverage. The bundled checker independently verifies the weighted conservation/dissipation identities. The publisher gives an exact publication date of 1 June 2017; a legacy journal portal also labels the article 'Published online: December 2016' without a day. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The theorem concerns model (1), finite mutation depth, and exact deterministic concentrations. It proves asymptotic antigen clearance but does not bound the biologically relevant clearance time and does not analyze the mutating-antigen extensions.

title: A finite germinal-center mutation chain forces eventual antigen clearance
